authority: Actual Core boss current position and saved three directions; actual WorldProjection. Board is an illustrative nominal diagram, NOT real Core output or collision validation.

core.launch: current boss position at emission; no homing or direction recomputation
core.endpoint: warning: current boss pos + saved direction * Core speed * Core lifetime; projectile: actual Core position, direction and remaining lifetime

style.shape: three separate black outer / white inner continuous direction lines, no fill, no slam ring, optional right facing arrow heads inside endpoint
style.warningLineWidth: 2sourcepx outer +1sourcepx inner scaled by actual projection, at least1screenpx; line width is NOT hit radius
style.lowFX: mandatory, stable, nonblinking; same warning regardless of lowFX
style.timing: visible only during actual Core warning, removed on emission; windup frames are three equal thirds of Core warning clock
mustNot: derive paths from sprite sizes or board scale
leave stale warning after emission or boss death
invent binding debuff or blocked passages

projectile.pose: faces right; rotate once by actual Core direction, never doubleflip
projectile.collision: Core radius0.16wu; visible links are not the collider
projectile.cleanup: remove on Core contact consumption, expiry or boss cleanup
